hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-[#0F172A]

layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense) for the 35 modules. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4.
layout.alignment: Left-aligned content for readability, strict optical alignment.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp corners (rounded-none), high contrast. Primary: bg-[#E65100] text-white hover:bg-[#BF360C] transition-colors. Secondary: border border-[#0F172A] text-[#0F172A] hover:bg-slate-100.
components.cards: Cardless/Flat aesthetic. 1px solid border (#E2E8F0), white background, rounded-none. Internal padding p-6. Hover: -translate-y-1, border-[#0F172A], shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,1)] for a slight neo-brutalist/editorial edge.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults overridden to rounded-none, 1px border. Focus ring: ring-2 ring-[#E65100] ring-offset-1.
components.navigation: Sticky, Solid white background or Glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl) with 1px bottom border border-border/40.

dashboard_spec.overview: Unified Dashboard displaying 35 module cards divided into 3 distinct sections.
dashboard_spec.flagship_treatment: Make these 6 modules stand out by applying col-span-2 on large screens, a distinct background color (e.g., very pale ochre or slate-50), and larger typography/icons. They should serve as the primary entry points.

image_urls.description: Architectural/historical frieze, good for an authoritative legal hero section if heavily tinted or used as a subtle background pattern.

motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in for dashboard grids to make data loading feel systematic.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to high contrast. Text on primary color must be pure white.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus states on all interactables, using ring-[#E65100].

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the provided Google/Fontshare font URLs into the global CSS or index.html.
Apply 'Cabinet Grotesk' to all headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' to body.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='chat-submit-btn').
Build the dashboard using a standard Tailwind CSS grid, breaking it into 3 clear sections for the categories.
Implement the 6 flagship modules with deeper logic as requested, using placeholder UI or actual logic (Forms, Chat UI, Analysis Results) for their respective pages/modals.
Avoid generic border-radius. Enforce rounded-none or rounded-sm to maintain the editorial/legal authority aesthetic.
Use the Saffron (#E65100) sparingly as a strict accent for primary CTAs and active states.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions (dropdown, calendar, toast). Use shadcn variants.
Provide design guidelines for .js files, not .tsx.
